title: SeedChain
description:
Ethereum blockchain-based approach for efficient product traceability in the agriculture supply chain that uses smart contracts and decentralized on-chain storage. The smart contract ensures data provenance, eliminates the need for intermediaries, and provides all stakeholders with a secure, immutable transaction history. 

Problems that arise : 
1 Seeds can be falsified 
      solution : Cryptographically verify using on-chain data
2 Key facilities may not meet quality standards
Solution :  • Publish inspection results to blockchain
                  • Verify presented inspection results
3 Seeds may not be recognized by destination countries
Solultion : • Verify signatures in presented certificates
